'''Theovor Mindak's wife''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] wife of [[Theovor Mindak]], with whom she had a daughter named [[Samara Mindak]]. One night, she was taken away from their home by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]], who never revealed her fate to her family, prompting her husband to despise the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] and join the [[Eagle's network]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Theovor Mindak's wife is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].
